tasks.label: ТВОЯ РОЛЬ
tasks.q: Ти вперше ступаєш на пісок Арракіса. Туфір дав тобі список правил безпеки — ти маєш переписати їх і роздати всім слугам. Але спершу треба дійти до палацу крізь натовп.
tasks.q_pl: Pierwszy raz stajesz na piasku Arrakis. Thufir dał ci listę zasad bezpieczeństwa — masz je przepisać i rozdać wszystkim sługom. Ale najpierw trzeba dojść do pałacu przez tłum.
tasks.q_en: You set foot on the sand of Arrakis for the first time. Thufir has given you a list of security rules: you must copy them out and hand them to every servant. But first you have to get through the crowd to the palace.

tasks.label: ПРАВИЛО
tasks.q: Must: strong obligation, often from the speaker or a rule (You must wear your shield). Have to: obligation from outside (You have to drink water every hour). Mustn't: it is forbidden (You mustn't look at the sun). Don't have to / needn't: it isn't necessary (The servants don't have to carry my maps). Past of must and have to: had to.
tasks.q_pl: Must: strong obligation, often from the speaker or a rule (You must wear your shield). Have to: obligation from outside (You have to drink water every hour). Mustn't: it is forbidden (You mustn't look at the sun). Don't have to / needn't: it isn't necessary (The servants don't have to carry my maps). Past of must and have to: had to.
tasks.q_en: Must: strong obligation, often from the speaker or a rule (You must wear your shield). Have to: obligation from outside (You have to drink water every hour). Mustn't: it is forbidden (You mustn't look at the sun). Don't have to / needn't: it isn't necessary (The servants don't have to carry my maps). Past of must and have to: had to.

end_good.title: Місію виконано!
end_good.text: Слуга полегшено зітхає й ховає список у кишеню. Раптом за вікном знову лунають крики натовпу. Ти чуєш те саме дивне слово, яке кричали Полові на полі: «Лісан аль-Ґаїб!»
end_good.text_pl: Sługa oddycha z ulgą i chowa listę do kieszeni. Nagle za oknem znów słychać krzyki tłumu. Słyszysz to samo dziwne słowo, które krzyczano do Paula na lądowisku: „Lisan al-Gaib!”
end_good.text_en: The servant sighs with relief and puts the list in his pocket. Suddenly the shouts of the crowd ring out again outside. You hear the same strange words they shouted at Paul on the landing field: “Lisan al-Gaib!”
